title: Bike: no more shivering off the side of the trail
kaylee: Ride off the side of the trail and Maple glides along the edge smoothly, instead of shivering and twitching for as long as she holds the push.

pictures.title: A robot holding the push toward the trail's side for 10 s
pictures.caption: Before: the bike's turning snapped back and forth, and Maple flicked into the air every few frames (pink). After: one smooth glide; only her real hops off the bumps are left.
